[2026-09-03T00:34:50.617Z] [world] In life it was a machinist, one hand fused half-around a wrench that rusted into the bone — you find yourself wanting to know their name, and knowing you never will. The ground gave them back without warning — one moment mud, the next a person who should be dead.
